F58.quote: The Readers Project is an aesthetically-directed framework for custom software agents that actively explore the culture of human reading. We call these agents ‘readers,’
F58.claim: a framework of custom software agents, 'readers', that explore the culture of human reading

F59.quote: Traces of the paths they take reveal them to be acting, also, as ‘text generators,’ writing machines visible within and beyond the text on which they run.
F59.claim: the readers act also as text generators, writing machines

F60.quote: Another outcome from this project is How It Is in Common Tongues an algorithmic reading, reconstruction, and reproduction of Samuel Beckett’s How It Is.
F60.claim: How It Is in Common Tongues: an algorithmic reading, reconstruction and reproduction of Beckett's How It Is

F61.quote: This project shows how electronic literature can serve as a kind of digital humanities, by informing and creating computational perspectives on close and distant readings of texts.
F61.claim: the editors: the project shows electronic literature serving as a kind of digital humanities
